nphi.title: Tracking Extreme Heat Impacts (GHHIN activity)
nphi.with: Robert Koch Institute; University of Sydney; London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine; IANPHI; Lancet Countdown; WHO; MCC
nphi.summary: A Global Heat Health Information Network workstream led by staff from Santé publique France and RKI. It is harmonising heat-health indicators and heat-impact registries, and it will produce guidance for NPHIs on setting up heat-health…

nphi.title: KITA SEHAT – Australia–Indonesia Partnership for Health Transformation
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Indonesia; Bappenas
nphi.summary: An eight-year Australia–Indonesia programme supporting primary health care policy and services, with a health security component that strengthens surveillance systems, workforce capacity and cross-sector coordination.

nphi.title: Five-nation public health institute exchanges on data sharing, digitalisation and AI
nphi.with: US CDC; Australian CDC; Public Health Agency of Canada; New Zealand public health agency
nphi.summary: UKHSA held regular meetings in 2024/25 with the public health institutes of the US, Australia, Canada and New Zealand on data sharing, digitalisation and artificial intelligence.

nphi.title: CSIRO/ACDP partnership program under Partnerships for a Healthy Region
nphi.actor: CSIRO Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness (ACDP)
nphi.with: Animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia; Pacific field diagnostic networks
nphi.type: Programme (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: AUD 24.2m CSIRO program (over AUD 12m via ACDP) strengthening animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia, testing at high-risk sites such as wildlife markets and boosting Pacific field diagnostic networks.

nphi.title: eLABorate – laboratory accuracy and biosafety for outbreak response (DFAT Strategic Partnership)
nphi.with: National public health laboratories of Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu and Kiribati
nphi.type: Project (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: VIDRL-led work area of the Doherty–DFAT Strategic Partnership (2024–2027) training Pacific national labs to expand molecular and serological testing with quality assurance and management.

nphi.title: HiT3 – Hepatitis B integration into Triple Elimination
nphi.actor: Doherty Institute (VIDRL / WHO CC for Viral Hepatitis)
nphi.with: Ministries of health of Vanuatu, Solomon Islands, Cambodia and Fiji
nphi.type: Project (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: Technical support under the Doherty–DFAT Strategic Partnership to integrate hepatitis B into triple-elimination programmes for mother-to-child transmission of HIV, syphilis and hepatitis B.

nphi.title: Pac-EVIPP+ – Pacific Evidence for Informed Policies and Programs Plus
nphi.with: Pacific Community (SPC); Fiji National University; SAFETYNET; ASEAN+3 FETN; ministries of health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded AU$7.5 million programme (2024–2028) to build the applied field epidemiology workforce in Pacific Island countries, Cambodia and Laos through advanced FETP pathways, mentorship and communities of practice.

nphi.title: Doherty Institute Strategic Partnership for Prevention, Surveillance and Response to Infectious Diseases across the Indo-Pacific
nphi.with: In-country university and laboratory partners (not individually named); Nossal Institute provides GEDSI/WASH expertise
nphi.summary: A four-year DFAT-funded partnership under Partnerships for a Healthy Region that builds workforce, laboratory and genomic surveillance capacity, AMR capacity and data for decision-making in Southeast Asia and the Pacific.

nphi.title: ACTUP – HIV drug resistance and viral load testing in Papua New Guinea
nphi.with: Papua New Guinea Institute of Medical Research (PNGIMR)
nphi.summary: A Kirby Institute project with PNGIMR, funded under Partnerships for a Healthy Region, that strengthens HIV drug resistance and viral load testing in PNG.

nphi.title: STRIVE – PNG Molecular Hub support
nphi.with: PNG Molecular Hub
nphi.summary: A Burnet Institute programme under Partnerships for a Healthy Region that supports the PNG Molecular Hub's laboratory capacity.

nphi.title: AIHW–SPC data for decision-making partnership in Pacific countries
nphi.actor: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW)
nphi.with: Pacific Community (SPC); ministries of health
nphi.summary: Under Partnerships for a Healthy Region, AIHW works with SPC to strengthen health data and its use for decision-making in five Pacific Island countries.

nphi.title: Fiji Pathogen Genomics Laboratory
nphi.with: Doherty Institute (MDU PHL, VIDRL, WHO CC for AMR); Australia DFAT; Pacific Community (SPC); WHO
nphi.summary: Fiji CDC launched its national pathogen genomics lab in Suva in May 2025 with support from the Doherty Institute's public health labs, DFAT, SPC and WHO (sequencing equipment, mentorship and training).

nphi.title: Kirby Institute – NCID Singapore MoU on infectious disease research
nphi.with: National Centre for Infectious Diseases (NCID), Singapore; Tan Tock Sen Hospital
nphi.summary: MoU announced in October 2023 to collaborate on immunovirology, surveillance, therapeutic studies and disease control programmes, building on joint work in the STRIVE respiratory infections network.

nphi.title: ACPHEED – regional ASEAN centre for public health emergencies (Thailand, Indonesia, Viet Nam)
nphi.actor: ASEAN Centre for Public Health Emergencies and Emerging Diseases (ACPHEED), secretariat hosted by Thailand
nphi.with: ASEAN Member States' health ministries; Japan-ASEAN Integration Fund (JAIF); Australian Government
nphi.summary: Regional ASEAN centre announced in November 2020 and set up across three host countries, with the secretariat office in Thailand and further hubs in Indonesia and Viet Nam; Japan committed US$50 million and Australia AU$21 million to…

nphi.title: APCOVE – Asia Pacific Consortium of Veterinary Epidemiology (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: Australian and New Zealand veterinary schools; national animal health services
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded consortium set up in 2020 to build veterinary epidemiology capacity for animal and zoonotic disease surveillance in eight Asia-Pacific countries.

nphi.title: ARIA-RISE – Regional Immunisation Support and Engagement
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS) – Australian Regional Immunisation Alliance (ARIA)
nphi.with: 20+ Australian research institutions (Menzies, MCRI, Burnet, Kirby, ANU, Telethon Kids); WHO; UNICEF; Gavi; regional ministries of health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded alliance hosted by NCIRS that supports immunisation programmes in the Pacific and Southeast Asia, including COVID-19 vaccine roll-out plans, measles outbreak support and immunisation training (RISE-2 continuing).

nphi.title: Pacific Public Health Surveillance Network (PPHSN) – LabNet, EpiNet, PacNet, PICNet
nphi.actor: Pacific Community (SPC) – Pacific Public Health Surveillance Network (PPHSN)
nphi.with: Health ministries of Pacific Island countries and territories; WHO; US CDC; ESR/PHF Science; Fiji National University; PIHOA; regional reference laboratories
nphi.summary: Regional surveillance network set up in 1996 under SPC and WHO, with a three-tier laboratory network (regional level-2 labs in Fiji, French Polynesia, Guam and New Caledonia; reference labs in Australia, New Zealand and the US), outbreak…

nphi.title: Australian CDC – WHO Western Pacific Regional Office cooperation on IHR core capacities
nphi.actor: Australian Centre for Disease Control (Australian CDC)
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for the Western Pacific (Manila)
nphi.summary: At the 2026 World Health Assembly, the WHO Western Pacific Regional Director and the Australian CDC's first Director-General agreed to work together on strengthening International Health Regulations core capacities across the region.…

nphi.title: KDCA – US CDC – IANPHI Asia-Pacific pandemic surveillance capacity workshop
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA, host); IANPHI; ECDC; UKHSA; ACPHEED; health authorities of 10 Asia-Pacific countries
nphi.summary: KDCA, US CDC and IANPHI co-hosted a workshop in Seoul in July 2025 for about 40 officials from 10 Asia-Pacific countries, plus ECDC, UKHSA and ACPHEED, to share surveillance data practices and strengthen pandemic surveillance cooperation.

nphi.title: WHO CC Melbourne hands-on influenza training for Thailand's National Influenza Centre
nphi.actor: WHO Collaborating Centre for Reference and Research on Influenza (Melbourne; Doherty Institute/VIDRL)
nphi.with: National Influenza Centre, Thailand
nphi.summary: The Melbourne WHO Collaborating Centre for influenza hosted Thai National Influenza Centre staff for laboratory training to strengthen influenza surveillance capacity.

nphi.title: KDCA-run GOARN tiered training for Korean responders (2024)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: GOARN (WHO); University of Western Australia; National Medical Center Korea
nphi.summary: KDCA held a multi-tier GOARN training programme from March 2024 in Seoul for 33 KDCA and National Medical Center staff, facilitated with a University of Western Australia expert; KDCA is a GOARN partner but had made no deployments by 2024.

nphi.title: NCIRS support to middle-income countries on NITAGs and immunisation provider education
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS)
nphi.with: Ministries of health; national immunisation technical advisory groups; Sydney Vietnam Institute; Gavi
nphi.summary: Gavi-funded two-year project in which NCIRS supports NITAG strengthening, including twinning between advisory groups, and builds country-led immunisation training in Fiji, Timor-Leste and Viet Nam.

nphi.title: Pacific Islands NITAG Support Project
nphi.actor: National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance (NCIRS)
nphi.with: WHO Division of Pacific Technical Support; University of Sydney; 15 Pacific Island countries and areas; Wellcome
nphi.summary: Wellcome-funded NCIRS work with WHO Pacific to understand and strengthen vaccine policy decision-making in Pacific Island countries, including an inter-regional workshop in Nadi in February 2024.

nphi.title: Interim Australian CDC – Singapore CDA bilateral exchange on establishing disease control agencies
nphi.with: Interim Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA), Singapore
nphi.summary: May 2024 bilateral meeting where the two newly forming agencies agreed to share their planning, take stock of progress and exchange lessons on setting up a national disease control agency.

nphi.title: IndoPacLab – strengthening laboratory and diagnostic capacity in the Indo-Pacific
nphi.with: Burnet Institute; Doherty Institute; CHAI; FIND; PNG National Laboratory Technical Working Group
nphi.summary: AUD 5.2m consortium funded via Australia's Global Fund contribution and the Indo-Pacific Centre for Health Security to strengthen national and peripheral laboratory and diagnostic capacity in PNG, Cambodia and Laos.

nphi.title: COMBAT-AMR – mitigating antimicrobial resistance in Pacific Island countries
nphi.with: Burnet Institute; Pacific Pathology Training Centre; Pacific Regional Infectious Diseases Association; WHO CC for AMR surveillance; DFAT Indo-Pacific Centre for Health Security
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded One Health AMR programme covering infection prevention and control, antimicrobial stewardship, laboratory surveillance and animal health surveillance in four Pacific countries.

nphi.title: Australia Indonesia Health Security Partnership (AIHSP) – human health component
nphi.actor: Ministry of Health, Indonesia (Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control)
nphi.with: DFAT; Directorate of Vector-Borne and Zoonotic Disease Prevention and Control
nphi.summary: Subsidiary arrangement signed in July 2020 for AU$7.5 million in Australian technical assistance (2020–2025) on One Health coordination, zoonotic preparedness, surveillance, laboratory capacity and epidemiologist training.

nphi.title: CSIRO – Eijkman Institute COVID-19 research partnership
nphi.with: Eijkman Institute for Molecular Biology; UN Pulse Lab Jakarta
nphi.summary: With AUD 1 million in Australian funding, CSIRO joined the Eijkman Institute's vaccine expert advisory panel. CSIRO's Data61 also worked with Pulse Lab Jakarta on predictive analytics for disease hotspots, to strengthen Indonesia's…

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Timor-Leste
nphi.with: National Health Laboratory (NHL); Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INSP); Ministry of Health; Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries
nphi.summary: With Fleming Fund country-grant support, Menzies works with Timor-Leste's National Health Laboratory, INSP and ministries to build microbiology and AMR surveillance capacity.

nphi.title: VIDRL mentoring of new National Influenza Centres in Bhutan, Maldives and Timor-Leste
nphi.actor: Victorian Infectious Diseases Reference Laboratory (VIDRL) – WHO CC for Reference and Research on Influenza
nphi.with: National public health laboratories of Bhutan, Maldives and Timor-Leste; WHO SEARO; US CDC WHO CC
nphi.summary: Together with WHO and the US CDC WHO Collaborating Centre, VIDRL trained and mentored senior staff at the public health laboratories of Bhutan, the Maldives and Timor-Leste. All three laboratories were then recognised as WHO National…

nphi.title: ASEAN-Australia Health Security Fellowships (Master of Applied Epidemiology)
nphi.with: ASEAN ministries of health; DFAT
nphi.summary: Fellowship programme agreed after the 2018 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, in which ASEAN health officials complete ANU's applied epidemiology degree while working in their home institutions and Australian fellows do field placements in…

nphi.title: Fiocruz – CSIRO letter of intent
nphi.with: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO)
nphi.summary: Letter of intent on scientific cooperation between Fiocruz and Australia's CSIRO.

nphi.title: ICMR – NHMRC (Australia) memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: National Health and Medical Research Council (NHMRC)
nphi.summary: ICMR and Australia's NHMRC signed an MoU in 2016, valid to 2026, covering joint research projects, scientific workshops and researcher exchanges. NHMRC reports that cooperation has mainly run through the Global Alliance for Chronic…

nphi.title: Lab-based influenza surveillance in Pacific Island countries (PPHSN)
nphi.actor: Institut Pasteur de Nouvelle-Calédonie (with Pacific Community)
nphi.with: Pacific Community (SPC); WHO National Influenza Centre at ESR; WHO CC for Influenza Melbourne; US CDC; Cook Islands, Guam, Wallis and Futuna
nphi.summary: US CDC-funded project from 2006 to set up laboratory-based influenza surveillance in Pacific Island countries, with confirmatory PCR at Institut Pasteur de Nouvelle-Calédonie and training at ESR and the Melbourne WHO collaborating centre.

nphi.title: Indo-Pacific Centre for Health Security support to PNGIMR
nphi.actor: Papua New Guinea Institute of Medical Research (PNGIMR)
nphi.with: DFAT Indo-Pacific Centre for Health Security; Australian research partner institutions; ACIAR
nphi.summary: Australian support to PNG's national medical research institute through a strategic adviser, matched core funding with Australian research partners and joint research (Applied Health Systems Research; One Health systems partnership with…

nphi.title: PaNDAS – Pacific Networked Diagnostics and Support
nphi.actor: CSIRO Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness (ACDP)
nphi.with: Australian and New Zealand reference laboratories; Pacific veterinary laboratories
nphi.summary: ACDP-led project to establish a Pacific Laboratory Network that standardises diagnostics and supports animal and zoonotic disease investigations in Pacific island countries.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Papua New Guinea
nphi.with: Central Public Health Laboratory (CPHL, planned national AMR reference lab); National Department of Health; Department of Agriculture and Livestock; NAQIA; CEPA; Port Moresby General Hospital; Doherty Institute
nphi.summary: Burnet Institute leads the Fleming Fund grant in PNG, renovating the Central Public Health Laboratory as the national AMR reference lab and strengthening One Health AMR data surveillance with the National Department of Health.

nphi.title: V-RESIST – reducing inappropriate antibiotic use in Viet Nam
nphi.with: National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology; Pasteur Institute; Vietnam Ministry of Health; National Lung Hospital; Hanoi Medical University; OUCRU; Karolinska Institutet; UNSW; Burnet; ANU
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded applied research grant (AU$2.48 million) to evaluate an intervention against inappropriate antibiotic use and study drivers of drug resistance in Viet Nam, with NIHE and the Pasteur Institute as partners.

nphi.title: STRONG TL – strengthening surveillance and operational research in Timor-Leste
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde (National Institute of Health) Timor-Leste; Universidade Nacional Timor Lorosa'e; NT Department of Health; ANU; Royal Darwin Hospital
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$2.12 million) to improve disease surveillance, national communicable disease guidelines and operational research capacity with Timor-Leste's National Institute of Health.

nphi.title: Real-time surveillance of malaria and vector-borne pathogens in Papua New Guinea
nphi.with: PNG Institute of Medical Research; Central Public Health Laboratory; PNG National Department of Health; WEHI; James Cook University; Australian Army Malaria Institute
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$3 million) for real-time surveillance of malaria and other vector-borne diseases, early warning of drug and insecticide resistance and outbreak decision tools, with PNGIMR and the Central Public Health Laboratory.

nphi.title: Multidrug-resistant TB and malaria in Indonesia and PNG
nphi.with: Indonesian Ministry of Health; Gadjah Mada University; Burnet Institute; University of Melbourne
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$3 million) on cost-effective treatment of drug-resistant malaria, TB case detection and prevention, and training local researchers.

nphi.title: Antibiotic dispensing by private drug sellers in Indonesia
nphi.with: Gadjah Mada University; Sebelas Maret University; LSHTM; George Institute for Global Health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$1.91 million) studying how private drug sellers dispense antibiotics and testing interventions to curb self-medication driving AMR.

nphi.title: Three Plagues – typhoid, dengue and leptospirosis in Fiji
nphi.with: Fiji Ministry of Health and Medical Services; Fiji National University; Edith Cowan University; WHO
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$2.01 million) developing mobile tools for water, sanitation and catchment management and training cross-sectoral outbreak teams against climate-sensitive infections in Fiji.

nphi.title: ADEPPt – applied epidemiology and problem-solving for PNG health workers and policymakers
nphi.with: PNG National Department of Health; University of Papua New Guinea; ANU; Hunter New England LHD; WHO
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$1.48 million) to train frontline health workers and senior policymakers in PNG to tackle local health system problems such as low vaccine uptake.

nphi.title: One Health and Health Security train-the-trainer course with Institut Pasteur HCMC
nphi.actor: University of Melbourne (Nossal Institute; Doherty Institute SPARK programme)
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur Ho Chi Minh City; Vietnam One Health University Network (VOHUN)
nphi.summary: Melbourne-led One Health and health security training, co-developed with VOHUN and Institut Pasteur HCMC and adapted for Vietnamese government staff, funded under the DFAT-supported SPARK programme.
